title: the proof of the pipeline catches a second search of a tool, and the promise says what is measured
intent: The wave that repairs the proof of the track D (the wave D0) for the third time: the discriminator of the package of the waves 84 and 86 named one finding that touches it (F22).  The code of the pipeline is honest; the proof was weaker than the promise.  The wave touches no code of the pipeline.  (1) **The chain of the search was proved by its writing** (F22): the probe looked for a **verbatim** copy of the body of the chain in the other scripts of `scripts/` and for the pair of steps `command -v' and `-x ... .nix-profile/bin/' in another file -- so a copy **rewritten** in other words (its own `type -P', its own `-f' for the profile) passed, and the pipeline answered 0 where it had to answer 1.  The class of escape was already named in the objection of wave 86 and in docs/PLAN.md section 16.77, and the new finding is not the escape itself: the finding is that **the text of the claim and of its falsifier were stronger than the proof**.  (2) The check now also looks at the **code of the pipeline** and refuses a step of the search of a tool written by the pipeline itself: the comments, the text of the help of `scripts/dev' and the calls of `find_tool' are excluded, and the rest of the code may not name the steps (`command -v', `type -P', `which', the profile of the user, the store of nix, the binary of a tool).  (3) **The promise is rewritten to what is measured**: the chain lives in one place **in `scripts/`**, `scripts/dev` reads it, calls it and writes no step of the search by itself, no other script of `scripts/` defines the chain or carries a copy of its body, a copy that is rewritten in other words **is not seen**, and the searches of the checks themselves are their own, by design -- the tree carries a search of its own in `tests/checks/check-the-state-diagram-comes-from-the-code.sh`, and the promise now says so instead of claiming the whole tree.
objection: The claim is about a proof and not about a picture of the site: the check runs the pipeline in a fixture and reads the pictures it wrote, but the pictures of the site itself are the waves D3 and D4.  The price is named and it is three prices.  (a) The new probe reads the **words of the code**, not the trace of the runtime: a step assembled on the fly (`c=comm; $c -v plantuml') is not seen.  (b) A copy of the chain in **another script of `scripts/`** that hides its steps in its own file and is called without a glob passes -- the same class of escape that the objection of wave 86 names, and the promise now says that a copy rewritten in other words is not seen.  (c) The sourcing of the chain behind a variable is still not recognised -- open in the objection of wave 86, and the runtime probes cover it only in part.  A fourth price is the price of the strictness: a search in `scripts/dev` that repeats all four steps of the chain is a violation as well, because the check cannot tell it from the chain by the proof and only by the writing.
refuted_by: a step of the chain of the search does not work alone, or the chain of the search is copied in a second place, or the pipeline does not read the chain from the place where it lives, or the pipeline writes a step of the search of a tool by itself, or the pipeline renders one theme only, or a diagram of the tree is not drawn, or a picture is not drawn from its own source, or a picture is drawn from a part of its source, or the pipeline answers with the code 0 when the tool is not there, or the pipeline answers with the code 0 when PlantUML fails or writes no picture, or the skins of the themes do not carry the colours of the site, or the control of the claim does not make the check fail by its own assertion
note: The claim of the wave is amended and not rewritten: the id `the-diagram-pipeline-renders-both-themes' is the same, the text says that the chain lives in one place **in `scripts/`**, that `scripts/dev` writes no step of the search of a tool by itself, that a copy of the body rewritten in other words is not seen, and that the searches of the checks themselves are their own; the `falsifier' names the new refusal, and the `control' is the same.  Ten controls were applied to copies of the tree on 2026-11-20 -- seven by the writer of the wave and three more by the parent, and the parent's three were made independently of the report of the writer.  Every one of them ended with the verdict the control asked for.  (1) The honest tree -- the code 0, in 26 seconds.  (2) `find_plantuml' writes a search of its own -- "scripts/dev writes a step of the search of a tool by itself [.nix-profile/bin NIX_STORE_DIR bin/plantuml type -P] -- the line: candidate=\"$(type -P plantuml 2>/dev/null || true)\": the chain of the search lives in one place (scripts/lib/tools.sh) and not in two"; code 1.  (3) The control of the claim -- "the pipeline drew [alpha-light.svg beta-light.svg state-machine-light.svg ] and not two pictures for every diagram" and "the picture of alpha (dark) is missing or empty"; code 1.  (4) The **old** check of wave 86 on the same mutation -- the code 0: the false green the finding is about.  The measurement of the wave: the check is 1015 lines and 40.6 kB (the wave 86 one was 940 lines and 36.9 kB), and it goes in 26 seconds; the file of the wave 86 check was not touched by this wave.
